validation.detail: Twelve pieces formed a thirteen-unit wall with column heights [3,2,3,2,3]. Fresh RGBD 94.24 seconds after the last release confirmed the silhouette remained, with height plateaus [85.5,57.5,85.5,56.5,88.5] mm above the local foam plane. Both arms withdrew, both grippers empty, complete feedback and no arm/gripper faults. Some yaw and overhang remain; no precision alignment, disturbance or repeatability claim. Empty grasps, multiple-object grasps, drops and rejected geometry candidates are preserved. Existing primitives reused; hardware settings and original site.json unchanged. Only the right wrist profile changed from 640x480 to 848x480 using task-specific config. Per-stage public action/reason summaries recorded in 87 real clips; final video validation is documented separately in the export README. Prior ACE success and incomplete towel tasks remain historical evidence. Local geometry references are not full hand-eye or TCP calibration.

calibration.scope: agilex56 right arm and recorded front-camera geometry only; not a full hand-eye/TCP calibration

validation.detail: Piper X; one front execution arm per USB-CAN. Shared client/report/geometry/phase deployed, 46 relevant offline tests passed, active control config and RGBD service unchanged. Both front arms and grippers now physically verified: right red bit and left green bit picked, carried and released into compartments containing matching colors. Empty grasp attempts retained; successful lifts measured right 9.2 mm and left 10.1 mm. Post-release close views and final unobstructed observe confirm both placements. Final grippers left 23.3 mm/right 23.9 mm, enabled; arm feedback complete, no arm or gripper fault. Prior paired lift and drawer pull remain historical evidence. Stop idle only. Calibration remains candidate and TCP unverified. Task-local contact references kept separate per arm; read fresh state before further actions.

calibration.scope: Two wrist-to-link6, fixed D455-to-bases and inter-base candidates. Per arm 22 training + 6 held-out poses, measured Piper X FK. Recomputed offline using this user-confirmed physical sheet: nominal 100 mm bar measures 93 mm, uniform 0.93 scaling assumed; square 27.9 mm / marker 20.46 mm. Wrist-chain holdout RMS left 2.625 mm/right 2.515 mm; inter-base combination RMS 2.906 mm. Residual scale/depth consistency, paper flatness and absolute point/TCP validation remain unverified; accepted_for_control=false. Nominal candidate and raw data preserved, active control config unchanged.

validation.detail: September 13: all 8 shared CLI tools deployed. Enabled both arms using native SDK, entered CAN control and recovered slightly out-of-range J2/J3 through normal low-speed joint commands. Original move_both then executed a 15 s paired lift; post-observe reports left +197.022 mm and right +197.546 mm relative to pre-recovery positions for +200 mm targets. Both grippers restored via existing tools after mode switch triggered closure. Both arms enabled, ctrl_mode=1, fault codes zero. No firmware/zero/limit or motion-source changes. Active stop only offline tested. Calibration sampling confirmed physical wrist associations: left/can1 camera 243722071316, right/can0 camera 243322070942.

calibration.scope: Three cameras: two wrist-to-link6 and fixed D455-to-both-bases candidates. 16 training + 4 held-out poses per arm. Uniform 0.93 printed scale is approximate. Wrist-chain held-out RMS left 4.392 mm/right 3.524 mm; inter-base RMS 6.32 mm and max 10.82 mm. No external absolute metrology/TCP validation; accepted_for_control=false; current control config and March results unchanged.
